title: Auditing two-stage MS/MS molecular retrieval on MassSpecGym v1.5: Reranking gains, candidate priors and spectrum dependence
abstract: arXiv:2611.28096v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Two-stage retrieval of molecular structures from tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) can benefit from candidate reranking, but benchmark gains may also reflect candidate priors, replicate spectra, precursor mass, and training-set coverage. We audit a two-stage retrieval system on the official MassSpecGym v1.5 split (17,556 test spectra). A data-safe DreaMS encoder and composite molecular fingerprints provide an initial shortlist; a support-gated reranker combines pair scores, candidate-relative peak coverage, and mass-feasibility features. The final system achieves 31.05% Recall@1, a 10.05-point gain over its Stage 1 ensemble, while preserving its 72.62% Recall@20. Replacing the query spectrum with one from a different molecule matched on adduct and precursor mass reduces Recall@1 by 9.0 points (15.3 points under molecule-balanced weighting); nevertheless, a training-mean spectrum retains 13.75% Recall@1, indicating substantial spectrum-indepe

translated_title: 对MassSpecGym v1.5上两阶段MS/MS分子检索的审计：重排序增益、候选先验与谱图依赖性
translated_abstract: 从串联质谱（MS/MS）中检索分子结构的两阶段方法可以通过候选重排序获益，但基准测试上的提升也可能反映候选先验、重复谱图、母离子质量以及训练集覆盖度等因素的影响。我们在官方MassSpecGym v1.5划分（17,556条测试谱图）上对一套两阶段检索系统进行了审计。一个数据安全的DreaMS编码器与复合分子指纹提供初始候选短名单；一个受支持度门控的重排序器则结合了配对分数、候选相对峰覆盖度和质量可行性特征。最终系统达到31.05%的Recall@1，比其第一阶段集成模型提升10.05个百分点，同时保持72.62%的Recall@20。将查询谱图替换为另一分子的谱图（匹配相同的加合形式与母离子质量）会使Recall@1下降9.0个百分点（在分子平衡加权下下降15.3个百分点）；然而，使用训练集均值谱图仍能保留13.75%的Recall@1，这表明系统存在相当程度的谱图独立性。
tldr: 本文在MassSpecGym v1.5上审计了一套两阶段MS/MS分子检索系统，证明支持度门控重排序器可将Recall@1提升10.05个百分点至31.05%，同时揭示其性能增益部分依赖候选先验且对谱图输入的依赖性有限。
en_tdlr: This paper audits a two-stage MS/MS molecular retrieval system on MassSpecGym v1.5, showing that a support-gated reranker lifts Recall@1 by 10.05 points to 31.05%, while revealing that its gains partly stem from candidate priors and limited dependence on the query spectrum.
